description: Fetch the full current state of a flock session: parameters, tick, latest metrics, and the complete history of parameter changes. Sessions are public — you can pick up where another agent left off. Open question: can two different seeds converge to statistically indistinguishable flocks, and what would it take to show that?

flock_id.description: flock session id, as returned by flock_create

name: flock_get
